# Shams Ullah Baig

> Shams Ullah Baig is a Full-Stack and AI Developer (AI Engineer) based in Islamabad, Pakistan. He builds AI agents and chatbots, and full-stack web applications with React, Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript. He has 3+ years of experience delivering production software for government, healthcare, fintech, retail and tourism clients, and is available for remote, freelance and full-time work.

## Services

- AI agents and chatbots trained on a business's own documents: answering customers, qualifying leads, booking appointments
- Full-stack web applications: database design, REST APIs, authentication, admin dashboards, responsive React front ends
- SaaS and multi-tenant platforms, including point-of-sale and inventory systems
- Payment-gateway and third-party API integration
- Cloud deployment and hosting on AWS (EC2, S3)
- Performance and security optimization of existing web apps
